description: Held-out cases written from each v2 control's intent, with patterns the curated corpus does not use (attribute access, f-strings, FastAPI decorators, psycopg placeholders, soft delete). expected is the label for the named control. Blind round-1 regression cases: log.info sink, admin class context, manual f-string mask, private_key, boolean projection. Blind round-3 regression cases: Django/DRF/ORM/CLI framework coverage. Blind round-4 regression cases: Flask/SQLAlchemy/GraphQL/Celery coverage. Blind round-5 regression cases: prose context, derived prefixes, admin path, dict(__dict__), helper cutoff. Interprocedural regression cases: helper returns, append-built admin payloads and credential sources in redirects. Round-6 regression cases: dynamic column lists, callee names, ORM instance deletes, helper-built queries and parameter flows. Round-7 regression cases: keyword parameter effects, masking calls and names, credential metadata, nested-call precision and constructor cutoffs. Cross-module regression case: imported producer names that state their payload.
